cases.name: JetBrains support intake and knowledge assistant with Rasa
cases.task: 支持入口统一、问题完整性检查、内部知识库问答和带上下文转人工
implementation: 输入完整性及输出质量检查
上下文随人工升级交接

sources.title: JetBrains Centralizes Developer Support at Scale With Rasa

evidence_locations.section: The Challenge / A Fragmented Entry Point Experience
evidence_locations.short_evidence: more than 100 separate contact forms and support entry points
validate that an incoming question is complete before generating a response
processing roughly 3,000 conversations per month and sustaining a CSAT score of 75–80%
actively expanding the agent’s coverage to additional entry points

metrics.name: monthly_conversations
metrics.denominator: 已上线的主要支持入口
metrics.interpretation: 生产使用规模，非抽取质量

metrics.name: CSAT
metrics.baseline: 来源定性称接近人工，未提供可比较人工数值
metrics.interpretation: 客户满意度，未披露抽样、回收率和公式

transferable_lessons: 按下游路由、检索、交接用途决定要收集的信息
知识库治理与抽取模型一起考虑
缺失信息和升级路径纳入流程
limitations: 供应商客户故事，未公开独立实验数据
未给模型、提示词和字段全表
不是已开源客户工程；不能将OSS功能推作该部署配置
excluded_claims: 顶部80% deflection rate未给正文口径，不用于主要成效结论
正文与信息卡用户量不一致，不使用其用户总量
